channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Sperm teamwork may be key to fertilization, study finds
item.description: A broad evolutionary study suggests that sperm from some species work in coordinated teams, challenging the idea of a solo race to the egg.

item.title: Star's death reveals hidden supermassive black hole
item.description: Astronomers discovered a dormant supermassive black hole about 30,000 light-years from its galaxy's center, the first such object found this way.

item.title: Osteoporosis drug shows promise in preventing spinal damage in study
item.description: Genetic mutations may trigger a cascade that causes spinal discs to harden and degenerate. Zebrafish with a faulty collagen gene showed similar effects.

item.title: Study links nearly half of dementia cases to modifiable risk factors
item.description: A long-term brain study found that smoking, high blood pressure, heart disease, and high cholesterol were strongly associated with cognitive decline.
